description.text:
We are looking for someone with a passion for new technology and industry trends to join an internal SaaS project using the latest Microsoft technologies. The project is based on .NET Core, Angular, Azure services, and other modern technologies and development practices.
Work at Blocshop

The work-life at Blocshop is not only about the number of lines of code, or production deployment.

We are huge coffee lovers so we tried to count the hectoliters of coffee we have drank since 2012.

Are you a developer & coffee lover, too? You might consider joining us.

What will you do?

Taking part in web application development using .NET Technology Stack
Adhering to Agile development principles and SCRUM practices
Assisting with effort estimations during Planning meetings
Assist in software architecture decisions and review team members’ code
Implementing modules using the full stack, from DB to front end, while following the architectural patterns set out and agreed to by the team
Collaborating with development teams located in Brno and Tbilisi, Georgia

What you need to be a part of the Blocshop team?

3+ years of professional experience with .NET Stack
Preferred, but not required some experience with any Javascript framework (Angular, React, Vue.js, etc.)
You have an understanding of such concepts as Microservices Architecture, DDD, CQRS, and TDD
You are familiar with building CI/CD pipelines
You have some experience with Azure services
You communicate easily in English

Even if you don't meet all of the above but are ready to take on this challenge, go ahead and apply anyway. We love your spirit!

What will you get from working at Blocshop?

Fast interview process: short intro talk with our recruiter, technical interview
An international team of motivated professionals with a passion for learning new technologies
The working schedule is flexible. Get work done when and where you're most productive!
20 vacation days + extra vacation during the Christmas holidays
Yearly performance-based bonuses
Competitive compensation and regular reviews
High-end laptops
Investment in the ongoing professional development
Access to sports facilities around the Czech Republic and workout sessions with a personal trainer
Centrally located office with all kinds of refreshments and a great nap room
Team buildings and hackathons
Our four stage recruitment process

01

Intro call

On a short 15-minute introduction call with our recruiter, you will discover the opportunities we have at the moment that match your skill set the best.

02

Technical interview

Professional interview with blocshop's lead architect. This is the important part. We want top software engineers on our team so this is your time to shine. Show us your expertise!

03

Meet the manager

If you are a junior developer we might ask you to meet the owner of blocshop or one of the hiring managers. This also involves a fun test that every one of our employees enjoyed taking. For senior professionals, we often skip this step.

04

Offer

We make you an offer. You accept it.

description.text:
We are looking for experienced AI developers to join our AI web app projects.
Work at Blocshop

At Blocshop, we believe that work-life is more than just lines of code and production deployments.

We're passionate about innovation, collaboration, and of course, coffee

Are you ready to continue your career as an AI Developer? Join us!

What will you do?

Develop web applications leveraging AI Models and APIs like ChatGPT and Llama2
Fine-tune existing AI models to optimize performance
Integrate AI solutions into web applications
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement
innovative AI-driven features
Stay updated with the latest advancements in AI technology and
best practices

What you need to be a part of the Blocshop team?

3+ years of professional experience in software development
Experience working with AI Models and APIs (e.g., ChatGPT, Llama2)
Proficiency in fine-tuning AI models
Strong understanding of web application development
Good knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript
Experience with a mainstream back-end stack (e.g., C#, node.js,
Python)
Excellent communication skills in English
Experience with training AI models is a plus, but not required
